title: Stirling Approximation for the Gamma Function

problemStatement.formal: \Gamma(n+1) \sim \sqrt{2\pi n}\,(n/e)^n, with supporting identities for gamma values and ratios.
problemStatement.plain: Extend the Stirling-formula development from factorials to gamma-function statements, including natural-number gamma identities, asymptotic ratios, lower bounds, and half-integer gamma formulas.
whyMatters: Connects the classical factorial asymptotic with gamma-function notation used throughout analysis and probability.
Builds reusable gamma identities for later asymptotic and special-function formalizations.

proven: `gamma_eq_factorial`, `gamma_one`, and `gamma_nat_pos` establish the basic natural-number gamma facts.
`gamma_isEquivalent_stirling` and `gamma_div_stirling_tendsto_one` state the Stirling-equivalence result for the gamma sequence.
`gamma_one_half`, `duplication_at_nat`, and `gamma_half_int_formula` cover key half-integer and duplication identities.
open: The record does not claim a full continuous Laplace-method proof for all positive real arguments; the verified development focuses on the sequence and special-value infrastructure.
knownResults.goal: Use the completed sequence-level gamma Stirling development as a base for broader real-variable gamma asymptotics.
